contents.text: Which mechanical seal is fitted to pump P-202?

The mechanical seal fitted to pump P-202 is PN-4471-B. The mechanical seal PN-4471-B is superseded by PN-4471-C on all CP-200 pumps, effective September 14, 2026. The next seal change for pump P-202 should use PN-4471-C.

Asset record: pump P-202
# Asset record: pump P-202
|---|---|
| Tag | P-202 |
| Model | CP-200 centrifugal pump |
| Duty | Cooling-water transfer, standby for P-201 |
| Seal-water valve | V-115 |

P-202 is the standby pump for P-201 and runs about 1,200 hours a year, mostly while P-201 is maintained.
Its manual is the CP-200 Centrifugal Pump Manual (2009).

SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
# SOP-FS-014: Mechanical seal replacement on CP-200 pumps
1. Apply lockout/tagout to the motor and isolate the seal-water and process lines, as safety bulletin SB-0932 requires.
4. Fit mechanical seal PN-4471-C.
Don't mix PN-4471-B and PN-4471-C parts.

Engineering change notice ECN-2291: CP-200 mechanical seal › Engineering change notice ECN-2291
| Title | CP-200 mechanical seal |
Effective September 14, 2026, mechanical seal PN-4471-B is superseded by PN-4471-C on all CP-200 pumps.
PN-4471-C has a silicon-carbide face rated for higher seal-water temperatures.
Fit PN-4471-C at the next seal replacement and quarantine remaining PN-4471-B stock.
Reason for the change: three PN-4471-B failures in 2026 were traced to wear of the carbon face at seal-water temperatures above 60 °C.
